'''2012 SoCal Grand Prix Brian Speight DS Set Your Course For Alderaan''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Brian Speight]] at [[2012 SoCal Grand Prix]] (Grand Prix).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|TA-D-setyourcourseforalderaan.gif}}
* '''Username:''' marines28
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Grand Prix
